item.text: I’m using the web-design-engineer skill to build a warm, precise visual system: ink-blue typography, a soft ivory canvas, and bright orange accents. The product schedule will be the centerpiece, with responsive navigation, working pricing controls, and expandable FAQs—all in one file.

The page will pair a bold, three-line hero with a detailed schedule and handoff preview. I’m using Manrope and DM Sans, an 8px spacing rhythm, restrained rounded corners, and subtle hover motion. The layout will shift from a desktop split view to a single column on mobile, while preserving access to every section.

All sections are now built, including the schedule illustration and handoff card. The billing toggle updates both prices and annual totals, and the mobile menu and FAQs are wired up. I’m checking the file for missing content, broken references, and interaction issues before handing it over.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
class Audit(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.ids=[]; self.refs=[]; self.tags=Counter(); self.details=0; self.in_details=False; self.stack=[]
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs=dict(attrs); self.tags[tag]+=1
        if 'id' in attrs: self.ids.append(attrs['id'])
        if attrs.get('href','').startswith('#') and len(attrs['href'])>1: self.refs.append(attrs['href'][1:])
    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs): self.handle_starttag(tag, attrs)
p=Path('index.html'); text=p.read_text(); audit=Audit(); audit.feed(text)
assert len(audit.ids)==len(set(audit.ids)), 'Duplicate IDs'
missing=set(audit.refs)-set(audit.ids)
assert missing=={'sign-in'}, missing
assert audit.tags['details']==5
assert audit.tags['h1']==1
assert '<img' not in text
assert 'scrollIntoView' not in text
for phrase in ['Northgate Labs','Corvid Systems','Halden Bank','Rotation builder','Swaps and overrides','Escalation policies','Handoff notes','Calendar sync','Fairness report','Dana Whitfield','Ravi Menon','Sofia Brandt','99.95%','© 2026 Rotaline, Inc.']:
    assert phrase in text, phrase
print(f'HTML audit passed: {len(audit.ids)} unique IDs, 5 FAQs, all required content groups present. File: {p.stat().st_size:,} bytes.')
PY"
